description: This header file defines inline functions for mapping MIME types to GStreamer capabilities (GstCaps) and vice versa, within the Rialto media server component. It includes functions to create GstCaps from MIME types and to convert a list of GstCaps to a set of MIME types, utilizing external classes like IGstWrapper and IMediaPipeline::MediaSource.

methods.name: createSimpleCapsFromMimeType
methods.description: Creates a GstCaps object representing simple capabilities based on the MIME type of the provided media source, using a mapping from MIME types to GStreamer media types.

methods.name: convertFromCapsVectorToMimeSet
methods.description: Converts a vector of GstCaps pointers into a set of MIME type strings by checking for intersections with predefined capabilities.
